label: MeteoSwiss radar
info:
Converts the MeteoSwiss precipitation radar (Open Data, RZC) into transparent PNG frames for the MeteoSwiss Complete For HA map.

Endpoints:
- GET /meteoswiss/radar/frames
- GET /meteoswiss/radar/frame?time=...
- GET /meteoswiss/radar/status (diagnostics)
